provider: Knowledge Network for Biocomplexity (KNB, NCEAS / UC Santa Barbara)

free_tier.stated: 5 GB free per user ('Store up to 5GB of data for free'), with DOIs for permanent publication.

retention.stated: 5 GB free per user ('Store up to 5GB of data for free'), with DOIs for permanent publication

egress.terms: Free public downloads with no metering; metadata is harvestable.

tooling: Web upload plus desktop metadata editors (Morpho), EML metadata standard, DOI minting; a Metacat REST API exists for reads.
chaining: 5 GB x accounts; no published per-dataset unlimited tier, so it does not chain to 500 GB without account multiplication.
limits_note: Per-account 5 GB aggregate is the binding constraint; ecological/environmental scope; EML metadata required.

identity_cost.detail: inferred from the category 'academic'; the source record states no identity cost, so this is a class assumption, not evidence

reliability_note: Long-lived (NCEAS, since 2003) and stable, but the 5 GB account cap makes it a metadata/DOI service rather than a bulk store.

evidence.proved: 'Store up to 5GB of data for free. The KNB also supports DOIs to permanently publish your data sets.'
